response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience with C++ or Rust in geospatial routing pipelines, despite having broad full-stack and open-source experience; their work with DLang and Node.js in GIS is relevant but does not meet the core technical requirements for routing tile optimization, low-latency data pipelines, or distributed systems at scale.
strengths: Extensive open-source GIS project experience with real-world deployment
Proven ability to learn and work across diverse tech stacks and languages
Strong track record in testing, CI/CD, and developer tooling
concerns: No demonstrated commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing or geospatial data pipelines
Lacks explicit experience with distributed systems, fault tolerance, or navigation data freshness
Primary technical focus is on JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang, not the required C++ stack
